A fix release of **cob-portal-mcp**.

## Fixed

- A wrong key or address no longer crashes Node on Windows after the error message ("Assertion failed ... async.c").
  The server now sets the exit code and lets Node close the HTTP connection, in place of `process.exit()`.
- `dist/cli.js` is stored as executable in git, so CI passes on Linux too.

## Install

```bash
npx -y cob-portal-mcp@0.2.1
```

Full history: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/callobuzz/cob-portal-mcp/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
